name: pi-security
description: Use Pi Security in Cursor IDE to investigate findings, review security posture, plan remediation, and get guidance while you build.

skills.name: ingest-markdown-report
skills.description: Submit one security report to Pi from inline Markdown and a .md or .markdown filename after tenant verification and fresh explicit confirmation. Reject attachments, local files, links, and binaries.

skills.name: investigate-finding
skills.description: Investigate Pi Security findings by listing, locating, explaining, summarizing, or comparing exact FND-XXX IDs, UUIDs, or Pi finding URLs. Read-only; use when the user needs evidence about a Pi finding.

skills.name: remediation-guidance
skills.description: Fetch existing Pi remediation guidance for a finding or vulnerable package, and optionally prepare one missing package plan after tenant verification and fresh explicit confirmation. Use when guidance is needed without code changes.

skills.name: review-security-posture
skills.description: Review Pi Security posture by combining threat-model application context with Code Gatekeeper pull-request and issue records. Read-only; use for tenant posture, coverage, and prioritization questions.

skills.name: secure-development-playbook
skills.description: Retrieve Pi secure-development guidance once for a stable engineering task, reconcile its coverage with current repository evidence, and submit targeted feedback only after tenant verification and fresh explicit confirmation.

skills.name: security-design-review
skills.description: Start one Pi Security design review from a supported Confluence or Notion URL or inline Markdown after tenant verification and fresh explicit confirmation. Reject attachments, local files, and binaries.
